subject: Enclave expansion & renewal — isolation cluster + term amendment
messages:
From: Claire Sunderland <claire.sunderland@sunderland.health>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Matt Reynolds <matt.reynolds@sunderland.health>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + isolation env expansion — timeline and term question

Hi Nikhil,

Our renewal is coming up at the end of July and we need to fold in an expansion request: two additional private clusters (dedicated VPCs) for workload isolation across EU and US, plus an air-gapped enclave for a regulated subset of workloads. We also want to align the term to a 36-month commitment for predictable billing — can you confirm if that changes lead times or pricing?

High level asks:
- New EU isolated cluster (GCP region) + US isolated cluster (AWS)
- Air-gapped enclave for PHI processing (on-prem edge site)
- Updated SLA for the enclaved nodes
- Any changes to data residency controls and SOC evidence for the enclave
- Rough timeline and PO process; procurement needs a pricing sheet and SOW to route internally

Attached a rough network diagram and the renewal window our procurement team expects.

Thanks,
Claire
Director, IT Operations
Sunderland Health

Attachments: network_diagram.png

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Sunderland <claire.sunderland@sunderland.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + isolation env expansion — timeline and term question

Claire — thanks for the clear summary. This is doable and appreciate the advance notice. Quick answers up front:
- 36-month term: yes — we can offer a term amendment with stepped discounts for a 36-month commit; I'll include numbers in the pricing sheet.
- Lead times: add ~8-10 weeks for the air-gapped site (hardware procurement and on-prem install), and ~4-6 weeks for additional cloud VPC clusters subject to capacity in the chosen regions.
- SLA: we can provide an enclave-specific SLA; need to confirm whether you require a different availability target or additional runbook guarantees.

Can we schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk procurement through the PO items and the SOW? I'll bring Marissa (SOW/pricing) and Grace (security/compliance). Vivek (infra) will add a technical lane for capacity/placement.

Proposed times: Fri 25 Jun 9:30am PT or 2:00pm PT. Which works?

Cheers,
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Sunderland <claire.sunderland@sunderland.health>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + isolation env expansion — timeline and term question

Claire — quick note on the security/compliance side before our call:

1) Air-gapped enclave: we treat the on-prem enclave as a private site. We will need:
   - Network connectivity details and an internal contact to coordinate provisioning
   - Confirmation on whether KMS will be customer-managed (HSM) or Redwood-managed
2) Evidence: SOC 2 reports and our architecture diagrams can be shared under NDA; for PHI workloads we'll also provide a runbook for data handling and retention settings.
3) Data residency: EU cluster will have encryption-at-rest and restricted egress by default; well include the relevant controls in the SOW.

If you have specific questionnaire items, drop them in the doc and Ill have our security team respond pre-call.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Head, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Sunderland <claire.sunderland@sunderland.health>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft SOW + pricing for enclave expansion (v2)

Claire, Nikhil — per our call this morning, attaching an initial SOW and a pricing/term sheet. Key points in the draft:
- Adds two private clusters (1x EU, 1x US) — configuration = 8x A100-equivalent GPUs per cluster, isolated VPCs, private peering configured
- Air-gapped enclave: SW package + deployment runbook + 2-day onsite install support (on-prem)
- Term structure: 36 months with a 12% uplift vs 12-month list (applied as a blended discount schedule)
- SLA: 99.9% for cloud clusters; 99.5% for air-gapped enclave (due to physical site dependencies)

Attachments included: Sunderland_SOW_v2.pdf, pricing_term_sheet.xlsx

Open items:
- Final confirmation of hardware profile for the enclave (customer-provided vs vendor-provided).
- Procurement-required billing contact and PO template.

If procurement can provide the PO template and a target sign date (we had July 29 as renewal cutoff), well push the SOW to legal for final redlines.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Sunderland_SOW_v2.pdf, pricing_term_sheet.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Sunderland <claire.sunderland@sunderland.health>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft SOW + pricing for enclave expansion (v2)

Couple of technical clarifications from infra:
- Capacity windows: EU region current pool shows 3-week provisioning for the requested GPU profile; US pool is 2-3 weeks. For the air-gapped site were estimating 8-10 weeks (lead depends on rack delivery and site access).
- Fallback plan: if EU cloud capacity is constrained at time of deployment we can offer a temporary cross-region replica with data residency controls enforced, with a migration window of 4 weeks.
- Network firewall: the enclave install requires outbound access only to a restricted Redwood endpoints list for license activation and telemetry; we need the procurement/network team to sign off on allowed IPs.

I'll prepare a short runbook snippet for the SOW outlining install milestones.

-Vivek
Senior Systems Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Matt Reynolds <matt.reynolds@sunderland.health>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Sunderland <claire.sunderland@sunderland.health>, Procurement Team <procurement@sunderland.health>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft SOW + pricing for enclave expansion (v2)

Team — thanks for the SOW and the clear timelines. Procurement is prepared to issue a PO contingent on the following:
1) Final SOW with hardware ownership clarified (we prefer customer-owned hardware for the enclave)
2) Updated pricing sheet showing the 36-month blended discount and billable milestone dates
3) DocuSign-ready signature page

We expect to submit the PO by July 8, with signed SOW shortly thereafter. Please send the DocuSign link and an updated SOW addressing item (1). Also include the list of Redwood IPs for firewall allowlist.

Thanks,
Matt Reynolds
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Sunderland Health
